related.title: 白鶴灘水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「比速與水輪機型式」與「事故中的負載調節與運轉禁區」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；白鶴灘水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Specific speed and turbine type" and "Load regulation and the forbidden zone in the accident" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Baihetan Hydropower Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦拱形重力壩、640 MW 機組與 2009 年事故後的重建和安全改造；白鶴灘水電站則以百萬瓩級機組、289 m 雙曲拱壩與低熱水泥全壩應用為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on an arch-gravity dam, 640 MW units and reconstruction and safety upgrades after the 2009 accident; Baihetan Hydropower Station centres on million-kilowatt units, a 289 m double-curvature arch dam and low-heat cement throughout, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「尾水管渦帶與運轉禁區」的模型移到白鶴灘水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水錘與導葉關閉規律」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Draft-tube vortex rope and restricted zones" to Baihetan Hydropower Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Water hammer and guide-vane closure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「比速與水輪機型式」與「事故中的負載調節與運轉禁區」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；白鶴灘水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Specific speed and turbine type" and "Load regulation and the forbidden zone in the accident" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Baihetan Hydropower Station must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 薩揚—舒申斯克水電站
history.text: 1963 年工程開始施工；1978 年首台機組發電；1985 年洪水嚴重破壞消力池底板；2009 年2 號機事故，廠房淹沒；2011 年岸邊溢洪道建成；2014 年重建完成，10 台新機組全部投產。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1963: Construction began. 1978: The first unit began generating. 1985: A flood severely damaged the stilling-basin slab. 2009: The unit 2 accident flooded the powerhouse. 2011: The bank spillway was completed. 2014: Reconstruction was completed with ten new units in service. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
